description: Paid: the Lite report for 29 USDC (default) or the Full report for 49 USDC (tier "full"), via x402 (scheme exact). The same reports as the $29 Lite and $49 Full reports on the website. Returns the full report as JSON plus a private report link. Call once without `payment` to get the x402 payment requirements, then call again with the same arguments plus `payment` set to the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value. Payment is settled only if the report is delivered. If the call fails or times out after you pay, call get_report again with the same arguments and the same payment to get the result; you are never charged twice. If your x402 client caps payments, raise the cap to at least 49 USDC to buy the Full report.
